component.name: Kustik Screenshot
component.summary: Screenshots and screen recordings, one shortcut away

description.p: Press Super+Shift+S to freeze the screen, select an area or a window, annotate and copy. Switch to video to record an area or the whole screen with microphone and system audio, then trim and export as video or GIF.
Works on GNOME, KDE Plasma, COSMIC, niri, Sway, Hyprland, river and X11 sessions. Everything stays on your computer.
